public_rationale: CBRE reports 1.4% vacancy and more than 80% preleasing of capacity under construction across eight primary North American data-center markets in H1 2026 [e1]. Low vacancy provides contrary context, but these capacity and leasing measures do not establish final outcomes by project count for the publication-date AI-project cohort [e1]. They cannot settle whether an overwhelming majority will ultimately remain unfinished or unused [e1].
limitations: The packet lacks a complete, deduplicated register of eligible projects planned or under construction at publication.
CBRE's market population and capacity measures do not match the required project cohort and project counts.
Preleasing does not demonstrate actual operational use.
The forecast supplies no deadline or numerical definition of 'vast majority'.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The vast majority of the AI data centers being planned or built will go unused and/or unfinished.

statement.excerpt: I believe the vast majority of these data centers go unused and/or unfinished, and that most AI startups will die once the venture capital subsidies dry up.

our_interpretation: The natural reference is the AI data-center buildout discussed immediately above, especially projects associated with Microsoft, Google, Meta and Amazon.
Freeze the project population at publication: projects then planned or under construction, excluding later announcements.
Count projects rather than dollars or megawatts because the sentence refers to data centers.
Read 'go unused and/or unfinished' as an ultimate project outcome, not ordinary construction work in progress or temporary vacancy.
'Vast majority' means an overwhelming majority. Do not silently replace it with a bare majority or an invented precise percentage.
'I believe' expresses confidence, not an antecedent condition. No deadline is stated.
criteria.support_condition: A defensible register of the publication-date cohort ultimately shows an overwhelming majority permanently abandoned before completion or retired without meaningful operational use.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A defensible register shows enough of that same cohort completed and meaningfully used that an overwhelming majority cannot have gone unfinished or unused; completion and use of more than half would suffice.

evidence.explanation: Low vacancy is contrary context to a broad expectation of unused facilities. However, CBRE measures capacity in eight North American markets, not eventual outcomes for the publication-date AI-project cohort.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Track eligible projects planned or under construction on May 26, 2026. Verified permanent abandonment or retirement without meaningful use for an overwhelming majority would support the forecast. Verified completion and meaningful use of more than half would contradict it. Delays, temporary vacancies and preleases alone would not settle it.
